missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Профессор' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'умный' is the predicate adjective.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate masculine noun. 'Профессора' is the accusative direct object of 'слушают'; for animate nouns the accusative takes the genitive ending. 'Студенты' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Профессора' is the genitive form showing whose book it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Профессору' is the dative form marking the person to whom the question is addressed. 'Вопрос' is the accusative object of 'задал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Профессором' is the instrumental form after 'с', expressing with whom one spoke. 'Известным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О профессоре' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural with irregular stress. 'Профессора' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают' with the stressed -а ending. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Профессоров' is the accusative plural equal to the genitive plural for animate nouns. 'Многих' agrees, and 'университета' is genitive showing affiliation.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. 'Профессорам' is the dative plural required by the short adjective 'благодарны'. 'Своим' agrees in the dative plural.

missions.phrase: В зале нет ни одного профессора.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Профессора' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'Ни одного' reinforces the absence in the masculine genitive.
